title: French Cheese Puffs
summary: Light, savoury choux puffs with a crisp shell and a soft, cheesy centre. Best served warm as a snack or appetiser.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Put the water, butter, and salt in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Tip in the flour all at once and beat hard with a wooden spoon until the mixture forms a smooth ball and pulls away from the sides of the pan.
Cook the dough for 1 minute, stirring, to dry it slightly, then remove from the heat.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition until the dough is glossy and thick.
Stir in the grated cheddar and black pepper.
Spoon or pipe small mounds onto the tray, leaving space between them.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until puffed, deep golden, and crisp. Serve warm.
